title: Minimum Borrower Age
description: Applicant must have reached legal contractual adulthood and minimum earning age (21 years).

title: Maximum Borrower Age at Maturity
description: Loan tenure must conclude before or at normal retirement age (65 years for salaried applicants).

title: Baseline Maximum Debt-to-Income (DTI)
description: Aggregate monthly debt obligations (existing debt + new loan EMI) should not exceed 50% of verified net income.

title: General Residential Mortgage LTV Ceiling
description: General maximum loan-to-value ceiling for secured residential property finance is 80%.
